spectral_representation.fallback: top-energy frames when fewer than 3 active frames remain
spectral_representation.centering: subtract median residual over inferential band

H1.interval: 95% content-reconstruction stability interval; not a generator-population confidence interval
H1.mlaad_adjustment: cross-fitted language nuisance reference recomputed independently within each split

H2.shape_endpoint: Pearson same-generator minus strict matched different-generator baseline
H2.support_endpoint: top-10% absolute-support Jaccard same-generator minus strict matched different-generator baseline
H2.baseline: different generator present in both languages; two orientations symmetrized
H2.inference: exact one-sided sign-flip over the five multilingual generators

H3a.identity: exact frozen checkpoint with verified learned weights/state
H3a.interpretation: corpus/domain plus speaker-distribution shift; not a pure causal corpus effect

H3b.definition: same nominal architecture + same language (English) + different corpus; checkpoint identity not guaranteed
H3b.null: random generator sets from the same canonical family within each dataset context; n_a/n_b preserved
H3b.multiplicity: Holm across exactly the five primary Pearson comparisons
H3b.decision_language: absence of significant positive correspondence does not prove absence of all architecture-related structure

H4.language_adjustment: cross-fitted same-language median reference excluding target generator
H4.generator_profile: median across languages of adjusted generator-language profiles
H4.multiplicity: Holm across all five confirmatory endpoints
H4.decision_rule: SUPPORTED only if family similarity is positive and Holm-significant, centroid is Holm-significant, balanced accuracy and macro-F1 are Holm-significant, and dispersion is not significant; otherwise INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE

family_specific_exploratory.contrast: within-family mean cosine minus mean cosine to generators outside the family
